title: Boomers are buying into the promise of monthly income from options ETFs, but there's a tax catch
summary_full: Covered call ETFs have been widely adopted by baby boomers to meet monthly income needs, but unlike most ETFs, the tax implications can be significant.
summary_public: Covered call ETFs have been widely adopted by baby boomers to meet monthly income needs, but unlike most ETFs, the tax implications can be significant.
